ui.agents.models.reading.title.role: Section heading in a team's detail pane
ui.agents.models.reading.title.tone: Plain noun phrase naming two technical readings
ui.agents.models.reading.title.note: Names the block that answers which model and reasoning effort each team member will run on, and which layer chose them.

ui.agents.models.reading.description.role: One-line explanation under the same heading
ui.agents.models.reading.description.tone: Neutral statement of what the rows below show
ui.agents.models.reading.description.note: The rows list an effective model and effort per member plus the layer each came from (the team, the agent's own pin, the tier map, or the session).

ui.agents.models.reading.session_model.role: Reading for a member that inherits the launching session's model
ui.agents.models.reading.session_model.note: The backend answers a null model with its source set to the session; this phrase is what stands in for the missing model id. Sentence case is deliberately avoided because it is read inside a line, not alone.

ui.agents.models.reading.tier.role: The model tier a reading resolved to
ui.agents.models.reading.tier.note: A model tier is a routing word (lo, med, hi), not a reasoning effort and not a model name.

placeholders.tier: Tier identifier from the backend (lo, med or hi); do not translate the identifier.

ui.agents.models.reading.effort.role: The reasoning effort a reading resolved to
ui.agents.models.reading.effort.note: A reasoning effort is one of the ladder words the backend accepts (auto, none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max).

placeholders.effort: Reasoning-effort identifier from the backend; do not translate the identifier.

ui.agents.models.reading.unavailable.role: Warning that a member could not start as configured
ui.agents.models.reading.unavailable.tone: Warning, stating the consequence then the backend's own reason
ui.agents.models.reading.unavailable.note: Shown beside the member whose tier is unconfigured or malformed. The reason text is the backend's own sentence and is not translated.

placeholders.reason: Backend sentence naming what is wrong with the tier; interpolate unchanged.

ui.agents.models.reading.read_failed.role: Notice that the effective reading could not be fetched
ui.agents.models.reading.read_failed.note: Used when the route failed for a reason other than its absence; a backend that predates the route shows nothing at all instead.

ui.agents.models.source.team.role: Layer label: the team set this value
ui.agents.models.source.team.tone: Lowercase phrase read inside a line, after the value it explains
ui.agents.models.source.team.note: The team here means this team's own member override, which is the strongest layer a roster entry owns.

ui.agents.models.source.row.role: Layer label: the agent or team row set this value
ui.agents.models.source.row.tone: Lowercase phrase read inside a line
ui.agents.models.source.row.note: The row is the agent's own registry entry and its effort tag, which applies to the member wherever it is used.

ui.agents.models.source.none.role: Layer label: nothing set the tier
ui.agents.models.source.none.tone: Lowercase phrase read inside a line
ui.agents.models.source.none.note: Means no tier is in play at all, so the model comes from the session.

ui.agents.models.source.tier.role: Layer label: the tier map set this value
ui.agents.models.source.tier.tone: Lowercase noun phrase read inside a line
ui.agents.models.source.tier.note: The tier map is the tier-to-model-and-effort table configured in Settings; the phrase names that table, not a translation of the word tier.

ui.agents.models.source.session.role: Layer label: the launching session set this value
ui.agents.models.source.session.tone: Lowercase noun phrase read inside a line
ui.agents.models.source.session.note: Used when the model comes from the session that launches the member rather than from any configured layer.

ui.agents.models.source.model_default.role: Layer label: the model's own default set this value
ui.agents.models.source.model_default.tone: Lowercase possessive phrase read inside a line
ui.agents.models.source.model_default.note: The weakest layer: no effort was requested, so the chosen model's built-in default applies.

ui.agents.models.override.tier_label.role: Accessible name of one member's model-tier select
ui.agents.models.override.tier_label.tone: Label naming the control and the member it belongs to
ui.agents.models.override.tier_label.note: The select's visible label sits above it and names the field; this string is the accessible name, and it has to identify the member because every row carries one of these controls.

placeholders.member: Member role name as stored in the team; do not translate the identifier.

ui.agents.models.override.tier_field.role: Visible label above one member's model-tier select
ui.agents.models.override.tier_field.tone: Short noun phrase in the app's sentence case
ui.agents.models.override.tier_field.note: Names the field itself, where the accessible name above also names the member. The two values side by side (a tier word and an effort word) are not self-describing, which is why the field is labelled on screen rather than by its aria-label alone.

ui.agents.models.override.effort_label.role: Accessible name of one member's reasoning-effort select
ui.agents.models.override.effort_label.tone: Label naming the control and the member it belongs to
ui.agents.models.override.effort_label.note: Same shape as the tier select's accessible name, for the second control in the same row.

placeholders.member: Member role name as stored in the team; do not translate the identifier.

ui.agents.models.override.effort_field.role: Visible label above one member's reasoning-effort select
ui.agents.models.override.effort_field.tone: Short noun phrase in the app's sentence case
ui.agents.models.override.effort_field.note: The companion of the model-tier field label; a reasoning effort is a different vocabulary from a model tier and the two must not be read as one control.

ui.agents.models.override.inherit.role: Select option meaning no override on this layer
ui.agents.models.override.inherit.note: Chosen when the operator wants the layer below to decide; it is the option a member with no override shows. The word is the one the agent tool uses for clearing a pin.

ui.agents.models.pin_reach.role: Note beside an agent's own effort pin, listing the teams that use it
ui.agents.models.pin_reach.note: Answers what an agent-level pin affects, since the pin is machine-wide and the teams are where it is felt. Shown only when at least one team uses the agent.
ui.agents.models.pin_reach.plural_guidance: Use CLDR branches needed by the target language. Keep the count as a plain argument where it appears, not as a formatted number.

placeholders.count: Number of teams that use this agent; nonnegative integer. Numeric plural selector.
placeholders.teams: Comma-separated team names, already joined; do not translate the names.
